title: dfmtools: Bayesian Inference of Dynamic Factor Models
description:
An R package that assists in the set-up of algorithms for Bayesian inference of dynamic factor models and factor augmented vector autoregressive models. Functions for posterior simulation and forecasting are largely based on the introductory texts of Chan, Koop, Poirier and Tobias (2019, ISBN: 9781108437493) and Lütkepohl (2006, ISBN: 9783540262398).

Posterior simulation itself is not implemented in R: src/core/ and inst/include/bayests/ are vendored copies of part of the core layer of BayesTS, and this package is a translation layer over it.
notes: The vendored BayesTS files carry BSD-3-Clause headers, which is compatible with the package license; inst/COPYRIGHTS lists them file by file and also notes that the bundled bem_dfmdata object is third-party data whose terms are not this package's to grant.
